findings.description: `check()` used to return True when a report was within policy. It now returns a list of problems, which is empty when the report is within policy. `decide()` still does `if check(report, rates): APPROVED`, so a non-empty list (violations) is truthy and the report is approved. A compliant report has an empty list, which is falsy, so it is sent to NEEDS_REVIEW. The approval decision is inverted.
findings.suggestion: Use `if not check(report, rates): report.status = Status.APPROVED else: report.status = Status.NEEDS_REVIEW`.
findings.title: decide() auto-approves reports that have policy violations
